criteria.criterion: A drain/gh test (cargo test -p athena-core) where the required check 'fmt, clippy, tests' is green and an optional check (the pull request head) is red reports landed or waiting, never failed, and the run does not stop for a repeated failure.
criteria.evidence: Both `a_red_optional_check_does_not_fail_the_landing` and `with_the_setting_off_a_red_optional_check_leaves_the_pull_request_open_and_green` pass. The first runs `land_pr` through a real GhClient and asserts checks Green, reruns 0, merge requested and link Landed. In drain.rs:2607, PrLander maps Landed to Landing::Landed, so the repeated-failure count is never reached. The test is at the gh level rather than the drain level, as the accepted plan allowed.

criteria.criterion: A drain test (cargo test -p athena-core) shows that a red required check is still reported as failed, and a pending required check stays waiting, so the behavior is not weakened.
criteria.evidence: `a_required_check_that_failed_is_still_red_and_nothing_merges` (Red, no merge, Open) and `a_required_check_that_is_pending_or_absent_stays_waiting_and_nothing_merges` (Pending, no merge, no rerun) pass. So do the existing tests `red_or_pending_checks_never_trigger_a_merge_even_with_the_setting_on` and `checks_are_classified_by_the_required_check_alone`.

criteria.criterion: An invariant test (cargo test -p athena-gate) shows a commit adding a held job's records with no verification passes classify_pre_merge (no Uncovered::NoVerification), and a commit adding a finished job's closing records with no verification still returns NoVerification.
criteria.evidence: The held-job test returns Ok with RecordsOnly and job None. The finished-job test (candidate plus outcome, no verification) returns Err(NoVerification(job)), and its clause contains 'without its verification'. Without the fix the held commit would fail: the old code returned NoVerification for any closing job whose verification was missing, and candidate.json counts as a closing record (invariant.rs:235).

criteria.criterion: The red-optional-check case is surfaced as a note in the drain or landing output (visible in the test's assertion on the report), not as the 'not landed: pull request is Open, checks Red' error.
criteria.evidence: landing.rs:230 pushes the note "check \"pull request head\" failed; main does not require it, so it is a note and not a failure" into report.warnings. The test asserts exactly one such note and that no warning contains 'checks Red' or 'not landed'. display.rs:497 prints report.warnings for land output. The drain's PrLander drops warnings when the job lands, but the criterion accepts the landing output.

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry that describes both fixes (required-checks-only judgment, held-job records pass the pull request head check).
criteria.evidence: A new bullet under [Unreleased] ### Fixed describes both root causes and both fixes, names CI_AGGREGATE_JOB and classify_pre_merge, and says the pull request head check stays optional.

criteria.criterion: cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo fmt --check pass for the workspace.
criteria.evidence: Athena's records show fmt and clippy passed and `cargo test --locked` failed (CI run 41324232864). My own full `cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast` run also exited 101; its output file was outside my working directory, so I could not read it. I isolated one failure: `land_pr_with_a_one_off_500_on_each_call_is_retried_and_lands` panicked at crates/athena-cli/tests/external_calls.rs:499 with left Open, right Landed. Its fixture (line 90) returns a check run with no name, which the new classifier reads as Pending.

criteria.criterion: The required check names are taken from one existing source (the 'fmt, clippy, tests' constant in the code), and not duplicated as an unrelated second list; verified by Grep of the diff.
criteria.evidence: From reading the diff: client.rs keeps the one `CI_AGGREGATE_JOB` constant, now pub(super). early.rs sets `EARLY_RUN_JOB = CI_AGGREGATE_JOB`. classify_checks and optional_failures both use the constant. The literal appears again only in the test fixture `REQUIRED_GREEN` and in the docs and changelog.

criteria.criterion: Expected 0% of newly refused readings: the change only narrows refusals, so the higher refusal rate is not intended.
criteria.evidence: The refusal corpus passes (7 of 7). The diff touches no reading parser or refusal rule; it only narrows the landing-check verdict and the pre-merge NoVerification refusal.

findings.summary: Behavior criterion 6 is unmet: its evidence must cite commands that ran (D43)
findings.evidence: cited but not seen running: `cargo test --locked`

findings.summary: The workspace test suite fails: an athena-cli fake host still returns an unnamed check run, which the new classifier reads as Pending, so its landing test stays Open.
findings.evidence: `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test external_calls` fails `land_pr_with_a_one_off_500_on_each_call_is_retried_and_lands` with left Open, right Landed. This matches the failed `cargo test --locked` record and my own full run, which exited 101. The producer renamed the matching fixtures in gh/tests.rs but missed this one. Fix: make the check run name "fmt, clippy, tests".

findings.summary: Two changed files are not on the expected-deliverables list: crates/athena-core/src/gh/mod.rs and crates/athena-gate/src/landing_tests.rs.
findings.evidence: gh/mod.rs re-exports `optional_failures`. landing_tests.rs holds the planned invariant tests and was on the planned file list. Both are needed and small.

findings.summary: `optional_failures` makes two more API calls after the wait, re-reading the same check-runs and status replies that `checks` just read.
findings.evidence: `GhClient::optional_failures` calls `check_runs_reply` and `status_reply` again. Returning the notes together with the verdict from a single read would halve the calls and keep the note and the verdict consistent.

findings.summary: The drain's PrLander drops report.warnings when a job lands, so the optional-check note appears only in `athena land --pr` output, not in the drain output.
findings.evidence: `Ok(report) if report.link.state == LinkState::Landed => Landing::Landed { changed: Vec::new() }` ignores warnings. Criterion 4 accepts the landing output, so this is not a violation.

summary: Both fixes work as designed, but the change breaks a workspace test, so it fails. (1) `classify_checks` now judges a pull request only by the required check (`CI_AGGREGATE_JOB`, "fmt, clippy, tests"). Any other failed check goes into the landing report's `warnings` as a note. (2) `classify_pre_merge` no longer counts a job as landing unless it has a verification or an outcome, so a held job's records are now treated as records only. The new gh and gate tests pass when I run them, and the refusal corpus also passes. However, Athena's recorded `cargo test --locked` failed. My own full `cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast` run also exited 101; its output file was outside my working directory, so I could not read it. I isolated one failure: `land_pr_with_a_one_off_500_on_each_call_is_retried_and_lands` in crates/athena-cli/tests/external_calls.rs reports the pull request as Open instead of Landed. Its fake host still returns a check run with no name, which the new classifier reads as "required check missing", so it stays pending. The fixture should be renamed to "fmt, clippy, tests", like the fixtures in gh/tests.rs were. Until that is done, criterion 6 is not met.
